ns2:course.label: Electronic Circuits I
ns2:course.description: The physics of semiconductor devices; theory and application of discrete and integrated devices in linear circuits; use of operational amplifiers and feedback; regulation, oscillators, and modulation; emphasizes practical experience. Lectures, problems, and laboratory. Same as CHEM 423. 5 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Offered Spring term only. Prerequisite: PHYS 401 and PHYS 435.
